blurb: Guests can enjoy a variety of craft beers, cocktails, frozen drinks, hard seltzers, and homemade sodas. The brewery features two on-site food vendors: Deft Pies serving Chicago tavern-style pizzas and Yellow Bell Tacos offering Texas BBQ-inspired tacos. The venue hosts live music, trivia nights, pottery workshops, and special events like Oktoberfest and steinholding competitions.
extraNote: All tables are first-come, first-served; no reservations for general seating · Private events can be arranged by contacting events@oldgreggbrewingco.com · Old Gregg Brewing Co. at Howard Post retail center
